reason: Convert to short snake_case names so they are easy to use in code
Dropped row-id and columns >90% empty: block, village, subtributary, sub_subtributary
Trim spaces and Title Case so the same name is never counted as two values
Fill missing river/basin details with 'Unknown' so no rows are lost
Text timestamps cannot be sorted or grouped by month; parsed to datetime
Codes as integers, coordinates and rainfall as floats
Dropped rows with unparseable dates, missing/negative rainfall or coordinates outside Kerala
One reading per station per day; keeps the first
Year/month/weekday columns make monthly and trend analysis easy
Kerala rainfall is driven by monsoon seasons, so season is a key category
IMD intensity classes (Very Light ... Extremely Heavy) for each reading
Station total rainfall and rank (1 = wettest) added to each row
Ordered by station then date for time-series use
